title: Janitorial Walkthrough Maintenance Log
subtitle: Janitorial Walkthrough: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Janitorial Walkthrough Maintenance Log covers cleaning zone, surface, fixture, supply point, waste stream, and service task. The facility cleaning coordinator records Janitorial Walkthrough events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Janitorial Walkthrough Maintenance Log keeps Janitorial Walkthrough exceptions visible until the facility cleaning coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Janitorial Walkthrough Maintenance Log at occupied rooms, restrooms, common areas, service closets, and restricted zones. Document cleaning zone, surface, fixture, supply point, waste stream, and service task identity before Janitorial Walkthrough begins. Compare cleaning zone, surface, fixture, supply point, waste stream, and service task findings with stated Janitorial Walkthrough criteria; route unresolved Janitorial Walkthrough issues to janitorial quality supervisor.

sections.title: Tracking period and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Janitorial Walkthrough, identify responsible parties, occupied rooms, restrooms, common areas, service closets, and restricted zones, and the linked cleaning zone, surface, fixture, supply point, waste stream, and service task source.

fields.label: Scope standard, service level, and prior deficiency reference

sections.title: Status events and next-control history
sections.guidance: Capture Janitorial Walkthrough facts for cleaning zone, surface, fixture, supply point, waste stream, and service task; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Janitorial Walkthrough tracked controls
items: Soil, residue, touchpoint, floor, and fixture condition
Waste, recycling, sharps, or special-stream handling
Chemical label, dilution, container, and storage condition
Room release, odor, damage, and recurring deficiency

sections.title: Tracking exception, status, and next update
sections.guidance: For Janitorial Walkthrough, preserve each open variance with its current state, accountable owner, and next dated update. Facility Cleaning Coordinator performs period review.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
items: Damaged surface or fixture outside cleaning scope
Restricted room or privacy boundary not cleared
Wet-floor or access control cannot be maintained
blocks.guidance: Pause Janitorial Walkthrough when an unknown exposure, restricted-area concern, public slip risk, or unresolved damage remains. Retain the available Janitorial Walkthrough proof and route unresolved cleaning zone, surface, fixture, supply point, waste stream, and service task scope to facility cleaning coordinator.
